Orbit keeps the destination centered at a fixed distance. Level keeps a steady height; Tilted rises and falls. It uses orbit pace. This is a camera move, not a gravitational orbit. Dragging or using Look ends the orbit and pauses.

The approach uses your camera speed, slows near the destination, and stops at a viewing distance. Looking around does not steer a guided approach.
